title: Can't add the 3rd floor printer on my new MacBook
body:
I just got a new MacBook and I can't add the 3rd floor printer (PRN-3F-01). When I try to add it in System Settings > Printers it says "The software for this printer isn't available". My old Windows laptop prints to it fine, so the printer itself works.

In the meantime I'm emailing documents to a colleague so they can print them for me.
